2609.11449.title: Prevalence Determines Precision:Silent Contamination in Detector-Defined Datasets
2609.11449.paper_summary: Many ML datasets are constructed by running a detector, heuristic, or model over candidate pools; accepted items become labels. Dataset precision is then governed by true-positive prevalence in each pool via Bayes, not solely by detector quality. Using one instrument and period, we hold a detector-defined event dataset plus an independent official index labeling every detected item as real or phantom. One detector, three pools yield phantom rates 81.7%, 9.0%, and 0.0%. Transferring precision from the two high-rate pools to the low-rate pool predicts 0.955 versus measured 0.183, a +422% error; the Bayes expression predicts all three within 3.3%. The detected response curve is an exact convex combination of a true-event and a phantom component (residual 1.1e-16), with phantoms outnumbering true events 473 to 308, so contamination is a second signal with detector-inherited shape, not additive noise. Contamination direction depends on the estimator: on identical windows one statistic is diluted and another inflated because its denominator is also contaminated. A common normalization turns the estimator into a mean of ratios whose expectation need not exist; on the same 335 events it returns 0.40 where the well-defined estimator returns 0.10.
2609.11449.paper_summary_zh: 許多機器學習數據集是通過在候選池上運行檢測器、啟發式方法或模型來構建的；被接受的項目成為標籤。數據集的精確度由每個池中真陽性出現的頻率通過貝葉斯法則來決定，而不僅僅是由檢測器的質量決定。使用一種工具和時間段，我們持有一個由檢測器定義的事件數據集，以及一個獨立的官方索引，將每個檢測到的項目標記為真實或虛假。一個檢測器、三個池的虛假率分別為81.7%、9.0%和0.0%。將兩個高虛假率池的精確度轉移到低虛假率池預測為0.955，而實測為0.183，誤差為+422%；貝葉斯表達式預測三者的誤差在3.3%以內。檢測到的響應曲線是由真實事件和虛假組件的精確凸組合（殘差1.1e-16）組成，虛假事件的數量為473，真實事件為308，因此污染是一個繼承檢測器形狀的第二信號，而不是附加噪聲。污染方向取決於估計器：在相同的窗口上，一個統計量被稀釋而另一個被膨脹，因為其分母也受到污染。一種常見的正規化將估計器轉換為比率的平均值，其期望不一定存在；在同樣的335個事件中，它返回0.40，而定義良好的估計器返回0.10。
